Westcliffe Inn
Westcliffe Inn is located in the Heart of the Wet Mountain Valley, between the rugged Sangre de Cristo Mountains to the West; and the Sierra Mojada, or Wet Mountains to the East, Westcliffe lies at an elevation of 7,888 feet.
The regional weather is pleasant with over 320 days of sunshine, with low humidity. Westcliffe and The Wet Mountain Valley averages 16.5 inches of precipitation per year.

Unmissable Experiences
Dive into Adventures and Fun
ATVING & OHVING
Custer County boasts incredible ATV and Jeep trails. Explore the Sangre de Cristo Mountains via S. Colony Lakes Road, Hermit Lake Road, or take Medano Pass to the Great Sand Dunes National Park for an unforgettable off-road adventure.
Explore
star gazing
Westcliffe, shielded from the Front Range’s bright lights, is a stargazer’s paradise. Ranked 9th in the world and 7th in the U.S. by the International Dark-Sky Association, it’s the perfect spot to explore the wonders of the night sky.
Explore
Cycling
Custer County offers cyclists stunning rides through majestic mountain peaks, vibrant wildlife, and ever-changing seasonal landscapes. Whether you're a casual rider or a seasoned cyclist, the scenic routes here are perfect for every level of adventure.
Explore
Fishing
Explore a variety of freshwater favorites, including Brown, Rainbow, Cutthroat, and Brook trout. With access to over 52 alpine lakes and 370 miles of scenic streams, your perfect fishing spot awaits!
Explore
Hiking
The Sangre de Cristo range is a hiker’s paradise, offering trails for all levels. Explore the 100+ mile Rainbow Trail or challenge yourself with five of Colorado’s iconic 14ers. Adventure awaits at every turn!
Explore
Hunting
Explore the Wet Mountain Valley with muzzleloading, rifle, or archery hunting. The area is rich with deer, elk, antelope, bear, mountain lion, and turkeys, offering an unforgettable experience for hunters of all kinds.
Explore
Horse riding
Experience the beauty of Custer County on horseback. For more details and booking, click the link below. Adventure awaits!
Explore
BISHOPS CASTLE
For over 60 years, Jim Bishop has crafted one of Colorado’s most remarkable landmarks, a stunning testament to determination and creativity. A must-see for visitors!
Explore
Snowmobiling
Monarch Snowmobile Tours & Rentals 719-539-2572
Explore
MISSION WOLF
Mission Wolf is a nonprofit wolf sanctuary in the Wet Mountain Valley, offering free educational experiences to the public. Dedicated to connecting people with nature, it’s a unique opportunity to learn about and appreciate these majestic animals.
Explore
GREAT SAND DUNES
Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve protects a stunning landscape of towering sand dunes, some reaching up to 750 feet. A unique natural wonder waiting to be explored!
Explore
ROYAL GORGE
The Royal Gorge Bridge, near Cañon City, Colorado, is a iconic attraction within the 360-acre Royal Gorge Bridge & Park. A must-visit destination for breathtaking views and thrilling adventures!
Explore
Enjoy the views
of the Milky Way and the Sangre de Cristo mountains
Westcliffe, Custer County, and the Wet Mountain Valley is Colorado’s last and best kept secret!
Westcliffe is Colorado’s first International Dark Sky community, and recognized as the highest elevation International Dark Sky Community in the world. Breathtaking views of the Milky Way Galaxy can be seen from town or anywhere in the valley.
Custer County is are home to hundreds of miles of hiking and cycling trails, fifty-four alpine lakes, has an air of the undiscovered. Colorado has blossomed, but Westcliffe is still a small Rocky-Mountain town that people love to visit.

Westcliffe Inn
Nestled in the heart of the stunning Wet Mountain Valley, Westcliffe Inn offers an unmatched retreat for travelers seeking tranquility, natural beauty, and comfort. Surrounded by the majestic Sangre de Cristo Mountains to the west and the rolling Sierra Mojada (Wet Mountains) to the east, our location provides breathtaking views at every turn.

What Our Guests say
About Us
My husband and I just spent 2 nights at Westcliffe Inn. While it's a basic hotel, it's been updated with new bathroom fixtures, nice linens, and it's been freshened up. The rooms were very clean. It was much nicer than we expected. The person that checked us in was very pleasant and welcoming. If we're in the area again we'd definitely stay here. It was a very pleasant stay.
Cathy Bombardier
My wife and I stayed 3 evening while exploring Westcliffe. Hiking, shopping and generally getting to know the area better. Westcliffe Inn was clean, and the staff very accommodating. We slept well, as the quietness was outstanding. The view out the front door was amazing with mountains and deer.
Jim Garling
